companyDescription: Advanced fission · Aurora powerhouse (15-75 MW) for AI data centers + fuel recycling and isotopes · broke ground on the first Aurora; ~$1.2B cash + securities · Altman-backed
priceNote: Live $25.57 (-3.0%) on Oct 26, 2026 — at its 52-week low ($25.40-$152.06), -83% from the Oct 2025 high. Market cap ~$4.76B. ~$1.2B of cash and marketable securities (per the last 10-Q).
summary: Oklo reports Q3 on Nov 6 (company-announced) at its 52-week low, -83% from the Oct 2025 peak. The selloff came from rates, repeated stock sales and a wider loss outlook, not from a broken thesis: Aurora broke ground in September, DOE approved the fuel-facility safety design, and the NRC pre-application step is guided for year-end. Consensus is $68.95 (+170%; clears the gate), but dispersion is extreme (Citi $10 vs Barclays $59). earnings_beat carries no tier-2 penalty. Written against the core Base optimism bias of +23.7pp (realized 14d P75 +6.6%, P90 +11.7%). Base +25% assumes a 1-3 month relief move on a milestone-heavy print, like the +14.8% after the Aug print. แนะนำ 2-3% ของ portfolio — Speculative.

catalysts.name: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.description: Company-announced for Nov 6. The read is Aurora construction progress after the September groundbreaking, the NRC pre-application readiness assessment timing, DOE fuel-facility milestones, and burn vs. ~$1.2B of cash and securities.

catalysts.name: NRC pre-application readiness assessment
catalysts.description: Oklo guided to an NRC pre-application readiness assessment later this year; first powerhouse online ~end of 2027.

risks: Pre-revenue (TTM ~$1.2M); first powerhouse online only ~end-2027 — earnings can't validate the thesis, only milestones can.
Extreme analyst dispersion (Citi $10 Sell vs Barclays $59 OW) — the consensus average hides real disagreement.
Repeated equity issuance has been a recurring overhang; spending is rising (2026 loss estimate widened to ~$0.94/share).
Highly rate-sensitive: -25% in one day during the Sep 2026 nuclear selloff.
NRC licensing timelines for advanced reactors have historically slipped.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds at 3.75-4.00% after the surprise Sep 16, 2026 hike (first since 2023). The Oct 27-28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold / ~7% +25bp as of Oct 25 — but hike odds briefly spiked to ~44% after the hot Sep CPI print on Oct 14, so the path stays two-sided.
macroRisk.inflationNote: September CPI +0.6% m/m, 3.7% y/y headline; core +0.3% m/m, 2.6% y/y — both above consensus. Headline re-acceleration keeps a further 2026 hike live.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: The purest long-duration rate trade on this board: pre-revenue, with cash flows from 2028+. The nuclear complex sold off on rising yields in Sep-Oct.
macroRisk.summary: HIGH — the Oct 28 FOMC is priced ~93% hold, but September CPI ran hot (3.7% headline) and a further 2026 hike is still live. October's growth/AI-infra selloff was largely a rates trade, so the decision and the dot path matter directly for this name's multiple.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE — a deeply de-rated nuclear leader into a confirmed Nov 6 print, but pre-revenue and the most rate-sensitive name here. The measured core median at-catalyst return is -6.9% with 74% of picks underwater at their event (n=54), so Entry 2 ($22.50-24) is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only.

catalystSpot.preRunup: No run-up: OKLO is at its 52-week low, -83% from the Oct 2025 high, after a sector-wide nuclear selloff on rising rates and repeated stock sales.

postWin.note: OKLO's own Aug 7, 2026 reaction (+14.8% on first revenue despite an EPS miss) and CRWV's Aug 2026 +15.5% margin beat — both high-beta infra names re-rating on a narrative milestone.

postLose.note: OKLO fell ~25% in the late-September 2026 rates-driven nuclear selloff (MarketBeat, Sep 28) — the realistic magnitude of a risk-off leg for this name.

spotSizing.reason: 3%. earnings_beat carries no tier-2 penalty (+1.8pp vs +1.4pp, n=42), but a pre-revenue print rarely changes fundamentals. Analyst dispersion is extreme ($10 Citi to $59 Barclays) and the name is rate-sensitive, so size stays small.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the earnings_beat medianMAE (-9.6%, n=42). A further break well under the 52-week low before Nov 6 means the rates selloff is still in control.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If Q3 pushes the NRC step or Aurora timeline into 2027+, or announces another raise, exit.

DOE อนุมัติการออกแบบความปลอดภัยโรงงานเชื้อเพลิง และขั้นตอนก่อนยื่นคำขอกับ NRC กำหนดภายในสิ้นปี เป้าเฉลี่ย $68.95 (+170% ผ่านเกณฑ์) แต่การกระจายของเป้าสูงมาก (Citi $10 vs Barclays $59) earnings_beat ไม่โดน tier-2 ลงโทษ เขียนโดยคำนึงถึง optimism bias ของ Base ใน core +23.7pp (P75 ที่เกิดจริงใน 14 วัน +6.6%, P90 +11.7%) Base +25% สมมติกรอบ 1-3 เดือนที่งบเต็มไปด้วย milestone ทำให้รีบาวด์ แบบ +14.8% หลังงบ ส.ค. แนะนำ 2-3% ของ portfolio — Speculative

macroRisk.summary: HIGH — ตลาดคาด FOMC 28 ต.ค. คงดอกเบี้ย ~93% แต่ CPI ก.ย. ร้อน (headline 3.7%) และยังอาจขึ้นได้อีกในปี 2026 แรงขายหุ้นเติบโต/AI infra เดือน ต.ค. ส่วนใหญ่มาจากดอกเบี้ย ผลประชุมและ dot plot จึงกระทบ multiple ของหุ้นตัวนี้โดยตรง
